_doc: Latency budget of the voice pipeline, milliseconds. Each stage is a lognormal fitted to {p50, p95} (p50 == p95 means constant). 'source' says where the number comes from: 'assumption' = NOT measured and NOT verified against vendor pages (no web access when written); 'measured: ...' = measured on the 2-vCPU x86 dev box by experiments/voice_latency/measure.py. Replace assumptions with bench numbers before quoting any of this.

wake_detect.source: measured: openWakeWord 0.4 'hey_jarvis'/'alexa' fired 121-153 ms after end of an espeak phrase (n=2); p95 assumption

earcon_start.source: assumption: pre-decoded earcon in RAM, ALSA period 10-20 ms + device buffer

net_sat_to_hub.source: assumption: Wi-Fi 2.4/5 GHz LAN, one audio frame, occasional retries

vad_endpoint.source: measured p50: silero-vad 6.2 with 300 ms hangover on our VO files; p95 assumption (measured p95 1.6 s is a labelling artefact of silencedetect vs VAD on intra-sentence pauses)

intent_rules.source: measured: 6 regex rules < 0.001 ms in Python; 1-3 ms covers dispatch/serialisation (assumption)

llm_output_tokens.source: assumption: one JSON tool call + short reply, tokens before the first speakable sentence

pi5_hailo10h.label: Raspberry Pi 5 (8 GB) + Hailo-10H M.2 AI accelerator

stt.source: assumption: Whisper-base/small class on Hailo-10H, non-streaming, decode after endpoint

llm_ttft.source: assumption: ~1-1.5B int4 LLM on Hailo-10H, short prompt with cached system prompt

tts_first_audio.source: assumption: Piper medium on Pi 5 CPU, first sentence

jetson_orin_nano_super.label: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super (8 GB)

stt.source: assumption: Whisper small/base, TensorRT or CTranslate2 GPU, decode after endpoint

llm_ttft.source: assumption: 3B Q4 LLM, llama.cpp CUDA, cached system prompt

tts_first_audio.source: assumption: Piper/VITS on GPU or CPU, first sentence

stt.source: assumption: Whisper small / large-v3-turbo class on GPU, decode after endpoint

llm_ttft.source: assumption: 7-8B Q4 LLM fully on GPU, cached system prompt

tts_first_audio.source: assumption: neural TTS on GPU, first sentence

devbox_cpu_measured.label: This dev box: 2 vCPU x86, no GPU (measured where possible)

stt.source: measured: whisper tiny.en int8 via sherpa-onnx, 2 threads, 13 command utterances (p50 1.6 s long)

llm_ttft.source: assumption: no LLM weights obtainable offline (huggingface.co blocked); 1B-class Q4 on 2 vCPU

tts_first_audio.source: measured: Piper en_US-amy-low (onnxruntime, 2 threads), first sentence
